title: Flashbang
description: Flashbang Nick with a bright screen flash and sound effect!

title: Zoom Camera
description: Zoom right in on Nick's camera for dramatic effect!

title: Q&A Question
description: Submit a question for Nick to answer on stream! (Points refunded if skipped)

title: Scuba
description: Scubaaaa Scubaaa sound alert.

title: Bazinga!
description: Bazinga! - Sheldon Cooper sound effect on stream.

title: Breaking News
description: Set a custom Breaking News ticker message at the bottom of the stream for 60 seconds!

title: VIP Status
description: Instant VIP badge status in chat! Thank you for the incredible stream support.

title: 12 Hour Stream
description: Lock Nick into completing a 12 Hour Stream! (Scheduled and announced on Discord if not current stream).

title: 24 Hour Stream
description: Lock Nick into completing a 24 Hour Stream! (Scheduled and announced on Discord if not current stream).

title: Choose Nick's Skin
description: Pick Nick's character skin for the next match.

title: Pick the Next Drop
description: Choose where Nick lands on the map for the upcoming match.

title: No Vehicles
description: Nick cannot use any vehicle for the next round (including riding with teammates!).

title: Loadout Ban
description: Ban one specific weapon class (e.g. Shotguns, Snipers) for the whole match.

title: One Chest Only
description: Nick can only open ONE chest the entire round (floor loot allowed).

title: Force Taunt
description: Force Nick to taunt seekers while hiding.

title: Late to the Game
description: Nick must stand still for 10 seconds at the start of the round before hiding.

title: The Chatter's Touch
description: Specify a color Nick must incorporate into his camouflage artwork.

title: One-Color Challenge
description: Nick can only use a single color to blend in for the entire round.

title: Full Repaint
description: Nick must wipe to pure white and start his camouflage from scratch.

title: Panic Paint
description: Nick must abandon his current hiding spot and repaint elsewhere!

title: Ban a Country
description: Ban one country from being guessed for the active round (International Mode).

title: No-Move Round
description: Nick cannot pan or move along roads for the round (No Move Challenge).

title: 50/50 Chat Hint
description: Chat gives Nick two country choices, one of which is correct.
